BattleText_MenuOptions.text: [PALETTE 5][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_SHADOW SKY_BLUE LIGHT_BLUE WHITE2]たたかう[CLEAR_TO 46]バッグ\nポケモン[CLEAR_TO 46]にげる
BattleText_MenuOptions.provenance: The Japanese cart's own words; only the alignment changes. The cart lines the two columns up with ideographic spaces ("たたかう　　バッグ / ポケモン　　にげる"), where every other cart uses the CLEAR_TO layout code ("FIGHT[CLEAR_TO 46]BAG / POKéMON[CLEAR_TO 46]RUN"); gen1recomp splits the battle menu into its four options on the line breaks and CLEAR_TO codes (src/core/game3/battle/ui.lua menu_labels), so the ideographic spaces would leave two options on one label.

BattleText_MenuOptionsSafari.text: [PALETTE 5][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_SHADOW SKY_BLUE LIGHT_BLUE WHITE2]ボール[CLEAR_TO 46]ポロック\nちかづく[CLEAR_TO 46]にげる
BattleText_MenuOptionsSafari.provenance: The Japanese cart's own words; only the alignment changes. The cart lines the two columns up with ideographic spaces ("ボール　　　ポロック / ちかづく　　にげる"), where every other cart uses the CLEAR_TO layout code ("BALL[CLEAR_TO 46][POKEBLOCK] / GO NEAR[CLEAR_TO 46]RUN"); see BattleText_MenuOptions.

BattleText_OpponentUsedMove.provenance: The cart's row is "[B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX][B_BUFF1]\n[B_BUFF2]": the particle and the ending appended to the move's name depend on the move (ChooseMoveUsedParticle and ChooseTypeOfMoveUsedString, pokeruby/src/battle_message.c:976, :1016). gen1recomp fills B_BUFF2 with the move's name and the cart's BattleText_Exclamation row ("！") and has no particle buffer, so the line takes the particle the cart prints for most moves (の, with the ！ ending); the same choice as Emerald's sText_AttackerUsedX (overrides/ja-Hrkt/rse/emerald_dialogue.json).
